message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to incoming data; the code simply reads images and configurations without validating their structure or content.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local filesystem paths (e.g., /media/ailab/DATA/facescrub2) with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks of any kind.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is present anywhere in the pipeline code shown.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads 'ir_se50.pth' via learner.load_state() without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to confirm the file's integrity before use.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: The optimizer used is a standard SGD with no DP mechanisms such as Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, or DP-SGD noise addition.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are used anywhere in the code; evaluation uses only standard validation data.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no held-out test set isolation enforced programmatically, no signing or hashing of evaluation data, and no use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The inference path (face_reader, prepare_facebank, infer) only checks image size for alignment but performs no shape/range/type validation on incoming images before passing them to the model.

No detected output bounds checks: The code applies a distance threshold (conf.threshold = 1.5) for identity decisions, but there are no NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or other output validation checks on the model's embeddings or similarity scores.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a face verification/recognition model (vision-based), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
